title: Tell your mother the prices

scenario.en: You are in the market. Your mother is at home. She asks you on the phone: how much is it?
scenario.ar: انت في السوق وأمك في البيت. سألتك في التليفون: بكام؟

source: "The shirt is one hundred pounds. The shoes are fifty pounds. Today the bag is free."

task.en: Tell your mother the three prices.

key_points.en: The shirt is one hundred pounds.

model_answer.en: The shirt is one hundred pounds, the shoes are fifty pounds, and the bag is free today.
model_answer.ar: القميص بمية جنيه، الجزمة بخمسين، والشنطة ببلاش النهارده.
